name: Open or closed badge
description: Whether the chosen store is taking orders now.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/store-open-badge", name: "Open or closed badge", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Whether the chosen store is taking orders now.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    If(condition: store.is_open, then: Badge(label: "Open now", tone: Tone.success), else: Badge(label: "Closed", tone: Tone.danger))
  )], data: [Data(name: "store", from: Client.store(), fetch: "client", type: Store)],
)
